VIP support is on target (10.6-10.8 Hz without shot input); its V2.1b overdrive is fluctuation-driven by the tonic-relative scaling.

R3 keep I0_VIP = 24.33 (premise to reduce VIP support contradicted by F1-F3)

reviewer_decisions.R1: B: gain-normalized zero-mean shot, s_c = I0_E * g_E / g_c with one common sigma. Derivation kept explicit: equal rate-fluctuation amplitude needs g_c * s_c = const, so s_c is proportional to 1/g_c (never g_c). Bracket sigma in {0.5, 1.0, 1.5} provisional until PV is resolved
reviewer_decisions.R2: P1: isolated PV F-I diagnostic (SCI-V21-BKG-PV-CALIBRATION); P2 (I0_PV = 3.6) rejected as converting a previously observed successful rate into a parameter choice
reviewer_decisions.R3: keep I0_VIP = 24.33; VIP overdrive repaired by decoupling fluctuation amplitude from tonic

regeneration_decisions_required: D1 PV mean support: isolated evaluation around onset 3.936-4.0 (target the lowest sustained isolated rate) or closed-loop network-supported calibration
D2 SST: tonic 0.59 below Hopf 0.763; isolated verification, tonic above onset, or accepted network support
D3 whether tonic must set the operating point per isolated class or only for the all-class network mean

regeneration_decisions.D1: no isolated PV retuning: keep I_PV = 2.8 as candidate support; no search around onset 3.936-4.0 and no independent closed-loop PV calibration. The defect at V_MID is r_PV(network) = 0, not r_PV(isolated) = 0
regeneration_decisions.D2: no isolated SST retuning: SST 10.7 Hz in the network at tonic 0.59 < Hopf 0.763 is functional recruitment; no isolated SST diagnostic
regeneration_decisions.D3: the coupled network operating point is authoritative: r_c* = F_c(I0_c + I_rec,c(r*)), not r_c* = F_c(I0_c). Tonic establishes support; the coupled network establishes the operating point
regeneration_decisions.retired_requirement: BKG1 'derive every class tonic from isolated 10 Hz F-I inversion' (prospective)
regeneration_decisions.noise_normalization_consequence: s_c = I0_E g_E / g_c cannot use isolated g_PV or g_SST. The relevant gain is the closed-network susceptibility g_c^net = d r_c / d I_c^private at r*, measured after a coupled operating point is frozen; then s_c proportional to 1 / g_c^net (never g_c^net)
regeneration_decisions.program: coupled mean operating point -> network susceptibility -> mean-zero fluctuation design -> full V2.1 gates
